paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben HaChotef Efrati, in Rabbi Yishmael’s name: Mishnah, end of Kilayim, chapter 3. Rabbi Yishmael taught Rabbi Meir at the beginning of his life, and Rabbi Yose ben HaChotef at the end of his life. So writes Rabbi Shimshon there in the Jerusalem Talmud’s name. Rabbi Yose ben HaChotef knew the truth better. So too Halikhot Olam, toward the end of the book. גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael] writes that Rabbi Yose Chatufah is buried in Kefar Meron; see Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai.
